values: What would you like help with today?
Scopes the requested task. Intent is a user report and has no external layer lookup.
How familiar are you with Medicare?
Changes teaching depth only. Never a suitability feature or a prerequisite for browsing.
What ZIP code do you live in?
Resolve permanent county/state separately from ZIP reference. Preserve ambiguous ZIPs and supported-year bounds.
When do you need Medicare coverage to start?
Requested start is distinct from actual entitlement, effective date and evidence observation date.
What health coverage do you have now?
Coverage categories do not identify an exact current policy. Keep current coverage as a baseline; G04/G13 remain.
Which doctors or hospitals would you like to keep?
Exact provider, location, offering/network and period are separate bindings. Missing result is unknown.
A medicine name is insufficient. Preserve each strength/form as a distinct reported item; intake collision is open.
Will you need routine care away from home?
Routine care, emergency care, residence and travel destinations have different meanings. G06 remains.
How would you prefer to balance monthly payments and costs when you get care?
Optional cost preference. Cannot establish a total-cost estimate or choose a coverage path alone.
What matters most when we compare your options?
Optional priorities explain tradeoffs. Stars are contract-level context, not personal fit or mandatory intake.
Keeps beneficiary and helper reports separate. Does not authorize family sharing. Unknown-summary defect is open.
Reuse T03. Ask only missing home/moving/seasonal meaning that changes a supported check.
Apply year/period to every layer join; reject 2026 evidence serving a 2027 claim. L15 is a dated operational snapshot.
Which Medicare parts do you have now?
A/B reported status differs from official entitlement and application/effective chronology.
Actual Part B month is not requested start and cannot substitute for Part A chronology.
How did you first qualify, or expect to qualify, for Medicare?
Basis/age band is conditional. Exact timing, personal premium and rights remain held where more precision is needed.
How do you get your A and B benefits now?
Separate current arrangement from a proposed change. Reuse sufficient T05 facts without re-asking.
Internal dependency check. Ask exact event/date only when an accepted rule can use it; source precision gap remains.
Is this coverage from someone who is still working?
Current work, retiree and COBRA distinctions prepare timing/coordination research; no personal finding follows.
Does the employer have 20 or more employees?
20/100 employee variants depend on basis/context. Fixed threshold cannot cover all branches; G10 remains.
When did the job or coverage end?
Job end and health-coverage end are separate dates with explicit precision. Child prompt is not a duplicate requirement.
Do you have a written notice saying your drug coverage counts as creditable (as good as Medicare’s standard coverage), and has there been a gap?
Notice, coverage period and gaps are reports. A yes/no answer is not independently verified creditable coverage.
Could a change affect anyone else’s coverage?
Dependent coverage consequences require actual administrator evidence. No other person data is collected by default.
Are you or your employer adding money to an HSA?
Internal source-rule dependency. HSA yes/no cannot determine retroactivity or tax consequences; G02/G07 remain.
For the Medigap option you want to explore, what coverage change or notice should we check?
Internal rights dependency. Bind exact notice/event/period and reviewed rule; avoid a generic proof questionnaire.
Was this your first Medicare Advantage plan, when did it start, and did you have Medigap before?
First MA, start date and prior Medigap are distinct historical facts. Exact rights/return remain separately held.
Are you replacing an existing Medigap policy?
Replacement report is not an underwriting exemption, guaranteed issue, continuity finding or binding quote.
Do you currently receive benefits from any of these programs?
Current named-program receipt differs from applied/pending, exact level and effective period. G09 remains.
For the Special Needs Plan type you want to explore, what exact qualifying program or plan confirmation do you have?
Internal exact-plan qualification check. Keep restricted offerings visible; unknown is not ineligible.
Where will you need routine care away from home?
Reuse T08 and volunteered places. Ask only missing place/need/period required by a supported access check.
What exact office and location should we use for each doctor or hospital?
Reuse T06. Internal doctor ID is not NPI; city alone may not identify an office. No network evidence means external hold.
What exact name, strength, form, and brand or generic preference should we use for each medicine?
Strength is not dose/frequency/quantity. Brand preference is optional and separate from actual product identity.
For each medicine, what quantity, days supply, exact pharmacy and retail or mail order should we use?
Quantity needs units. Retail/mail, days supply and exact store need own evidence; no default 30/90-day fill.
Is this given at a clinic or filled at a pharmacy?
Internal missing discriminator only, such as method/device where supported. Clinic versus pharmacy is not a complete rule.
Is there a monthly amount you want to stay under?
Optional stated constraint only. Distinguish premium-only versus total/additional cost; no routine budget interview.
Which military or veterans’ coverage do you have?
VA/TRICARE/other program category is not exact coordination evidence. Keep the reported program visible.
Is there a coverage interruption you need help with now?
Internal urgency/continuity check; LI NET eligibility and local contact service availability remain separate.
What should I correct about the specific detail we were discussing?
Integrity and correction, not external evidence. Invalidate only affected reports/results and preserve unrelated facts.
When does the job-based health coverage end?
Maps to RC11.coverageEnd; deduplicate with parent and preserve separate jobEnd.
Maps to RC16.start; parent supplies the question context. Requested future start does not substitute.
Did you have Medigap before it?
Maps to RC16.priorMedigap; parent history is a report, not a return-right determination.
